description.description: A firefighter in a dark blue uniform with yellow reflective stripes and a yellow helmet is spraying water onto a destroyed, burning vehicle. Thick white smoke and orange flames rise from the mangled wreckage of the car, which sits on a ground covered in gray rubble. In the bottom left corner, there is a logo of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine consisting of a trident inside a star and the text in Ukrainian. The scene appears to be in an urban area with a building partially visible on the left and bare trees in the background.
An apartment building in Ukraine heavily damaged by shelling, with a large pile of rubble in the foreground and smoke rising from the collapsed structure. Rescuers are visible in the wreckage.

A group of first responders and civilians navigate a debris-filled street in a war-torn urban area. In the background, severely damaged residential buildings with blown-out windows are visible. A burned-out car frame sits amidst the rubble. Rescue workers in high-visibility gear and others in civilian clothing are seen helping individuals through the destruction.

The image shows two rescuers from the State Emergency Service of Ukraine working amidst the heavy rubble of a destroyed building. They are wearing dark protective gear with lime-green reflective stripes and helmets. One rescuer is holding a large hose or pipe. Smoke or dust fills the air in the background of the debris, which consists of concrete slabs, metal, and brick.
